ticker_news.title: Why Micron Stock Popped Again on Monday
ticker_news.description: Micron's stock rose as multiple Wall Street analysts raised price targets, driven by increasing DRAM demand from AI companies and potential significant memory margin expansion in server markets.
ticker_news.author: Rich Smith

ticker_news.title: Forget Meta And Microsoft — 'Pick And Shovel' Stocks Are The AI 'Capex Super Boom' Play
ticker_news.description: BlackRock strategist Ben Powell suggests investing in infrastructure companies supporting AI development, rather than big tech hyperscalers, as the AI capex spending continues to accelerate.
ticker_news.author: Erica Kollmann

ticker_news.title: AlphaTON Capital Deploys First H200 GPUs on Cocoon AI Network, Launches Revolutionary #OwnYourNode Program to Democratize AI Infrastructure Ownership
ticker_news.description: AlphaTON Capital successfully deployed NVIDIA H200 GPUs on Telegram's Cocoon AI Network and launched the #OwnYourNode program, enabling individuals and institutions to purchase fractionalized GPU ownership and participate in decentralized AI infrastructure.
ticker_news.author: Brittany Kaiser

ticker_news.title: The Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) Offers Broader Diversification Than the Vanguard Mega Cap Growth ETF (MGK)
ticker_news.description: The Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) offers broader market diversification with lower expenses and higher dividend yield compared to the more tech-concentrated Vanguard Mega Cap Growth ETF (MGK).
ticker_news.author: Cory Renauer
